title: gomphocentrum rhizanthium
intro: Gomphocentrum rhizanthium, commonly known as the Yellow Passionflower or Yellow Passion Vine, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and pain, due to its potential health benefits such as promoting relaxation and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gomphocentrum rhizanthium are attributed to its ability to interact with the central nervous system, exhibiting sedative and anxiolytic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
